name: Stretch Slide
description: The first clip stretches out long as it shoots away to one side, pulling in the second clip squashed behind it, which overshoots and springs back to its shape. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the clips slide (x right, y up)

params.name: stretch
params.description: How long the first clip stretches and how much the squashed second clip bulges

params.name: bounce
params.description: How far the second clip overshoots before it springs back to its shape
